name: apprenti.dev Application Security Engineering
audience: Software engineers who already ship application code and are specializing into application security engineering
philosophy: Defensive AppSec as engineering: model the threats that apply to a system you own, find the defects, fix them, and prove each fix with inspectable evidence. This path is not a CTF. LEARN BY DOING. GROW THROUGH MENTORSHIP.
corePlatforms: A local HTTP application the apprentice owns or operates
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks may restrict solution generation while allowing explanations, hints and quizzes.
The apprentice remains accountable for every finding, fix and verification submitted.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated defensive judgment and evidence, not on a scan score or an AI-written report.
